orgName: Saudi Cup meeting (Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia)

source.name: Jockey Club of Saudi Arabia - Royal Champion Proves His Class In Neom Turf Cup
source.note: 'the Group 1 USD$3m Neom Turf Cup Presented by Howden'. NEOM's name is the race title; Howden is the presenting partner (separate entry).

note: Race naming (NEOM in the race title), 2026 meeting. NEOM is a PIF giga-project. The race has run under the Neom name since 2022 per JCSA's Story So Far page.
